tools_helpful.evidence: session-log L3553: validator flagged a residual `CaptureElement` identifier left in an XAML comment on MainPage.xaml line 40, which the agent then sanitized (L3561).

tool_limitations.limitation: Only proves the process stayed alive; it cannot tell the agent that the single migrated page renders BLANK (controls present in the UIA tree but nothing visible). The build/validate gates were all green yet the scored screenshot was byte-uniform white.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Not fixable in the migration skill (no screenshot capability may be added per scope); reinforce in prose that a deferred-content page must carry a visible declarative placeholder so 'green gates' cannot mask a blank page.

failed_apis.why_tried: It is the hero control of the sample (the live camera preview surface PreviewControl).
failed_apis.root_cause: No WinUI 3 desktop equivalent (MediaPlayerElement is playback-only).
failed_apis.fix: Deferred per skill; replaced with a fallback TextBlock. Correct per PATTERNS.md#capture.

special_apis.special_handling: Defer (no migration path). Skill is correct that the type cannot be faked, but it gives no positive instruction to leave a VISIBLE placeholder in the deferred control's place, so the resulting page rendered blank.

errors_encountered.error: Residual UWP API identifier `CaptureElement` left inside an XAML comment
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent named the original API in a placeholder comment; the validator residue grep flags any unsupported-API token even in comments.
errors_encountered.fix: Rewrote the comment to reference PATTERNS.md#capture instead of the API name (session-log L3561).

dev_agent_struggles.where: MainPage.xaml / MainPage.xaml.cs — substituting the deferred CaptureElement
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The migrated single page renders fully blank/white (two byte-identical 7464-byte captures). The fallback message is in the UIA tree but not visibly rendered; the only static controls (two overlay buttons) are anchored HorizontalAlignment=Right and are clipped off the right edge at x=1248 in a 1280-wide window.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Single pass; the agent never visually verified the page because the only launch tool (Test-AppLaunch) proves process-alive only.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: When a page's entire visible surface is a deferred/unsupported hero control, the migration leaves the page with no reliably-visible content: the substitute text was assigned in OnNavigatedTo (code-path dependent) rather than a declarative, always-visible XAML placeholder, and the remaining static controls were anchored flush to the window edge.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — shipped blank; scored fail.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Skill guidance to replace a deferred hero/preview control with a VISIBLE declarative XAML placeholder (a Border filling the cell + centered TextBlock) so the page is never blank, and to not rely on OnNavigatedTo/Loaded to populate the only visible content.

env_issues.issue: No camera attached on the validation machine, so both buttons are disabled in both UWP and WinUI builds.
env_issues.workaround: This matched the UWP golden (buttons disabled), so it is not a new behavioral regression; the failure is the blank render, not the disabled buttons.
